components.notes: Revision v0.2, 16MB quad flash, 8MB 3.3V octal PSRAM; exact development board manufacturer/revision unconfirmed. Owner readings 2026-11-12 (measurements/modules/esp32-s3-physical-20261112.json): PCB 28 x 57 x 1.55 mm, 6.5 mm antenna overhang (63.5 mm overall), tallest part 4.7 mm above the PCB underside, no mounting holes, 2 x 22 header pins (order assumed from Espressif DevKitC-1, hardware/esp32-s3-header.json). Size shown is the PCB plus antenna footprint and the tallest part.

ILI9341 electrically identified in original project; landscape 320x240. Owner readings 2026-11-12 (measurements/modules/display-physical-20261112.json): PCB 86 x 50 x 1.6 mm, screen 69.25 x 50 mm, whole stack 8.3 mm including the SD slot, four 3.15 mm holes, 14-pin header.
Separate SPI bus; saved affine calibration in desk-touch NVS namespace

Left I2S channel; no audio retention or speech service in bench firmware. The size shown is the PCB diameter twice and the 26 mm full height including wires, not a part height.

Button processor adopted 2026-11-11; reads 15 buttons and sends their state to the S3 over UART. Board size and header positions from Espressif's dimensions drawing (hardware/devkitc-v4-header.json), not measured on the owner's board. Thickness and heights not given.

Owner confirmed 2026-11-12 that this is the controller's battery and that its size is recorded in another of his enclosure projects: 65 x 36 x 10 mm, recorded there as a plain box (nominal, not measured from a pack in hand). Connector, capacity and wire details not recorded. Separate from BAT1, the gamepad's original pack.
